description: A debug webpage for Leaflet map rendering, including styled map container, tile layer setup, map initialization, marker creation, and event handling for dragging events.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Sets the initial geographic center and zoom level of the map.

methods.name: addLayer
methods.description: Adds a tile layer to the map.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element that contains the map.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Adds event listeners to map or marker objects for 'drag' events.
